newsitem.title: USA: Hilton files proxy materials on ITT bid.
newsitem.headline: Hilton files proxy materials on ITT bid.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp on Monday said it filed preliminary proxy materials in connection with its $55 per share offer for ITT Corp.
Hilton said that it planned to ask ITT shareholders at the annual meeting in May to elect up to 25 Hilton nominees to the ITT board of directors.
It said the nominees were expected to facilitate Hilton's acquisition of ITT, subject to their fiduciary duties,
Hilton also said it would ask ITT shareholders to approve resolutions to ask the ITT board to accept the offer.
